bearer.description: Native apps: the token from the `set-auth-token` header of a sign-in.

cookie.name: better-auth.session_token
cookie.description: The web: the Better Auth session cookie (`__Secure-better-auth.session_token` over https).

AccountConflict.description: POST /me/accounts/link, 409: that sign-in already has its own account.

groupColor.description: The group's tile colour token (`t1`–`t5`), behind the item's icon; null without a group.

width.description: Pixels, for images and GIFs (null for files).

thumbnailUrl.description: A smaller JPEG/PNG preview for photos, or a Wallet pass's logo; null for GIFs (show `url`, animated) and files.

pass.description: For `kind: 'pass'` (an Apple Wallet .pkpass / .pkpasses): what to show on its card. Null otherwise.

Attachment.description: A photo, GIF or file in a chat message. URLs are signed and expire after about a week: refetch the message for fresh ones.

checkedUntil.description: Synced members whose calendars are only checked up to `until` (ISO instant), before the end of this range.

preferredBy.description: Members whose preferences this day's time that works fits (only on `match` days).

partial.description: A `match` day whose best time only meets the group's quorum (someone's missing).

title.description: Calendar busy: the event's name, when the calendar gives one. Only ever sent to its owner.

eventKey.description: Calendar busy: the event's opaque key ('' when the calendar gives no ids).

recurring.description: Calendar busy: the event repeats (so "not busy" can cover every occurrence).

ignoreId.description: Set when you've marked this event not busy: the id to undo it with. It doesn't count as busy.

syncUntil.description: Phone calendars: how far ahead the app should read (ISO instant). Null for server calendars.

url.description: https link (to copy, and for Google Calendar's "From URL").

webcalUrl.description: The same feed as webcal://, which Apple Calendar and Outlook subscribe to.

mostFree.description: With a quorum or optional members: when enough of the group is free (includes everyoneFree).

image.description: The group's photo, shown instead of the monogram tile; null for none.

archived.description: Archived by an admin: listed in the groups list's collapsed Archived section.

autoArchive.description: Archived automatically once its latest event has passed and nothing else is planned (admins choose).

rhythm.description: How often the group meets ("roughly monthly"), used to suggest the next plan; null for none.

image.description: A cover photo; null for none.

email.description: Who it was emailed to (only they can join with it), or null for a link anyone can use.

username.description: Who it was sent to by username (only they can join with it), or null.

name.description: The account name of the person it was sent to in Activity (by username or user id), or null.

maxUses.description: How many people can join with it (null: no limit). Always 1 for an invite for one person.

uses.description: How many people have joined with it so far.

GroupInvite.description: An invite that can still be used (`GET /groups/:id/invites`).

authorId.description: Null if the sender has deleted their account.

GroupMediaItem.description: A photo or file on a chat's media page, with the message it was sent in.

kind.description: `dates`: from–to (inclusive dates). `weekly`: the weekdays (empty = any), optionally within a window.

GroupPreference.description: A member's preferred time for a group. A guideline: it never blocks a date.

image.description: The group's photo, shown instead of the monogram tile; null for none.

archived.description: Archived by an admin: listed in the groups list's collapsed Archived section.

memberPreview.description: First few members, for avatar stacks.

email.description: Who an emailed invite is for (null for a link anyone can use).

username.description: Who it was sent to by username, or null.

personal.description: Sent to one person's Activity, so they can decline it.

InvitePreview.description: GET /invites/:token: what the invite page shows before joining.

InvitesCreated.description: POST /groups/:id/invites (token, url and expiresAt are the first invite's).

joined.description: False when you were already a member.

image.description: The group's photo, shown instead of the monogram tile; null for none.

archived.description: Archived by an admin: listed in the groups list's collapsed Archived section.

autoArchive.description: Archived automatically once its latest event has passed and nothing else is planned (admins choose).

rhythm.description: How often the group meets ("roughly monthly"), used to suggest the next plan; null for none.

linked.description: Apple / Google sign-ins on this account (email always works too), with the address that sign-in uses when known.

LinkProvider.description: Sign-in providers that can be linked to an account.

merged.description: Another account was merged into this one.

name.description: The name they go by in this group: `nameInGroup` when set, else their account name.

nameInGroup.description: The name they chose for this group, or null to use their account name.

MergeCandidate.description: The account a sign-in already belongs to, shown before merging it into yours.

editedAt.description: When the author last edited the text, or null.

deleted.description: Deleted by its author: shown as "This message was deleted" (body is null).

replyTo.description: A compact preview of the message this one replies to, or null.

attachments.description: Photos, GIFs and files sent with it, in order (empty for most messages, and once deleted).

caption.description: With attachments, `body` is the caption or (with none) a short summary such as "📷 Photo" for older apps; `caption` is just the caption, or null. Null for messages without attachments.

location.description: A place shared in the chat (a one-off pin). `body` is then a fallback for older apps; null once deleted.

name.description: A place's name ("Dishoom Shoreditch"), or null for "my location".

accuracy.description: How precise a device's position was, in metres; null for a searched place.

MessageLocation.description: A place shared in a chat message: where it is and, if it's a named place, what it's called.

text.description: A short one-line snippet: the text, or a poll's question. Null once deleted.

MessageReply.description: The quoted message shown above a reply, as it is now (edits and deletion included).

hasMore.description: More matched than `limit`: search for something more specific.

truncated.description: More replies than the server returns (the earliest are kept).

MessageThread.description: A message's thread: the first message of its chain of replies, then every reply under it, oldest first.

image.description: A cover photo; null for none.

MyPlan.description: A plan from any of your groups, with your reply (null: added straight to the calendar, nobody was asked).

going.description: Upcoming ones you said yes or maybe to, haven't replied to, or that went straight on the calendar (soonest first).

notGoing.description: Upcoming ones you said you can't make.

past.description: The last year, newest first (at most 100).

target.description: The date the rhythm points at (YYYY-MM-DD).

slot.description: The free time nearest it (within a week or so either side), or null if none.

off.description: Categories whose pushes (and emails) are off. Activity still lists everything.

quietHours.description: No pushes between these local times (in your time zone), e.g. 22:00–07:00; null for none. With `catchUp`, one push when they end says what came in meanwhile (if anything did).

mutes.description: Groups you've muted: no pushes from them until `until` (null = until you unmute).

proUntil.description: When Pro ends (or renews); null on free or lifetime.

store.description: Where it was bought: app_store, play_store, stripe, rc_billing, promotional.

groupLimit.description: Groups you can own on this plan; null is unlimited.

purchase.description: RevenueCat public SDK keys, null when billing isn't set up (hide purchase UI).

aiPlanner.description: The optional AI planner is set up on this server (it still needs Pro to use).

PlannerResult.description: POST /groups/:id/planner (Pro): a suggested time, ideas and a plan.

options.description: A date poll's options each carry `slot` (the time it stands for); text polls have none.

confirmedBy.description: Confirmed proposals: who confirmed it before everyone had accepted ("Confirm anyway"), null when it confirmed itself because everyone accepted.

needsReview.description: Confirmed proposals: someone who was coming can't make it any more, and the proposer or an admin hasn't yet chosen to keep the plan (`POST /proposals/:id/keep`) or cancel it.

busyMemberIds.description: Open proposals only: members whose calendars or blocks say they're busy at this time.

droppedOut.description: Confirmed proposals: said they can't make it after it was confirmed, not yet reviewed (see `needsReview`).

quorum.description: "Most of us are free": a time works when at least this many of the required members (synced, not optional) are free. Null or absent: everyone.

optionalMemberIds.description: Members who never stop a time from working (they're shown as missing when busy).

RequirementPreview.description: POST /requirements/preview: slots the timing produces before anyone's busy time.

RequirementTemplate.description: A saved timing to reuse when creating groups.

prompt.description: After each plan, post "Same again?" in the chat with the next free time near the rhythm.

preferredBy.description: Members whose preferences this slot fits.

score.description: Pro: the "best date" score (higher is better), weighing preferences and who's compromised before.

fairFor.description: Pro: people this time suits who've compromised in the group's recent plans.

missingMemberIds.description: Synced members busy at this time (with a quorum or optional members); empty when everyone's free.

SlotNoun.description: What one slot is called: "2 weekends work", "3 evenings work".

image.description: A cover photo; null for none.

busyBufferMinutes.description: Minutes counted as busy before and after each busy time when finding free slots (0 = none).

eventReminders.description: Pushes before a confirmed plan you're going to: the day before, an hour before, both or none.

showAddToCalendar.description: Shows "Add to calendar" on plans (off for people who subscribe to their plans instead).

autoArchiveNewGroups.description: Groups you create start with auto-archive on (archived once their latest plan has passed).

problem.description: Why it can't be used as written, or null.

available.description: Free to take (valid and nobody has it, or it's already yours).

user.description: Who has it, when someone does (you included).

passTypeIdentifier.description: With serialNumber, identifies the pass (e.g. to tell whether it is already in Wallet).

relevantDate.description: When it is for (the event, the flight…), ISO 8601 UTC, or null.

fields.description: Up to four of its fields, most important first.

count.description: How many passes the file holds (a .pkpasses bundle; details are the first one's).

WalletPass.description: Details read from a Wallet pass's pass.json (English text where it is localised).

value.description: The text, or with `date` an ISO 8601 UTC date-time to show in the reader's own format.
